questions.text: In Double DQN, which network selects the next action and which evaluates its value in the bootstrap target?

options.A: The target network selects; the online network evaluates.
options.B: The online network selects; the target network evaluates.
options.C: The online network both selects and evaluates.
options.D: The target network both selects and evaluates.

questions.explanation: Double DQN uses online Q values for argmax action selection and target-network Q values to evaluate that chosen action, reducing maximization bias.

questions.text: A DQN run begins gradient updates when its replay buffer holds only 20 nearly identical transitions. What change best addresses the lesson’s cold-start warning?

options.A: Wait until the buffer has many varied transitions before training.
options.B: Increase the target sync frequency to every transition.
options.C: Clip every reward to zero until the buffer is full.
options.D: Turn off replay and train directly on each new transition.

questions.explanation: DQN should collect a replay warmup before training so early updates are not fitted to a tiny, correlated sample.

questions.text: In QNet.forward, suppose one hidden unit has weights [2, -1], input [1, 3], and bias 0. What hidden activation does ReLU produce?

options.B: 0, because ReLU clips a negative weighted sum.
options.C: 1, because the input values are both positive.
options.D: 5, because ReLU adds the input magnitudes.

questions.explanation: The weighted sum is 2×1 + (−1)×3 = −1. ReLU computes max(0,−1)=0.
